rules.name: The Deadly Seven Theme Posse
rules.description:
In an OUTLAWS/HEX/ENLIGHTENED Force, instead of a Faction Posse, Earle Shepherd may take this Theme Posse.

If all six slots are filled with at least one unit in the Posse, then all units in the Posse gain the Prodigious rule.  Earle Shepherd is the only unit with the BOSS Trait permitted in this Posse.

rules.name: Honour Among Thieves Theme Posse
rules.description:
In an OUTLAWS/HEX/ENLIGHTENED Force, instead of a Faction Posse, Jesse James may take this Theme Posse.

If all six slots are filled with at least one unit in the Posse, then Jesse James and all FACES in the Posse gain the Prodigious rule.  Jesse James is the only unit with the BOSS trait permitted in this Posse.

rules.name: The Golden Army Theme Posse
rules.description:
In an OUTLAWS/ENLIGHTENED/HEX Force, instead of a Faction Posse, Pancho Villa may take this Theme Posse.

If all six slots in the Posse contain at least one unit in each, then all Inexperienced units in the Posse do not suffer casualties for being Disordered or Stunned. Pancho Villa is the only unit with the BOSS Trait permitted in this Posse.

rules.name: The Conquistadores Theme Posse
rules.description: In an OUTLAWS/ORDER/WARRIOR NATION Force, instead of a Faction Posse, Juan Ponce de Leon may take this Theme Posse.  If all six slots in the Posse contain at least one unit in each, then all units in the Posse ignore attribute penalties for the Stunned and Disordered Conditions, though they still count as having the Condition. Juan Ponce de Leon is the only unit with the BOSS Trait permitted in this Posse.

forceEntries.name: The Faithful of Castilla Theme Posse

rules.name: The Faithful of Castilla Theme Posse
rules.description: In an OUTLAWS/ORDER/WARRIOR NATION Force, instead of a Faction Posse, Madre Monica Perez may take this Theme Posse.  If at least three slots in the Posse contain at least one unit in each, then all units in the Posse ignore attribute penalties for the Stunned and Disordered Conditions, though they still count as having the Condition. Madre Monica Perez is the only unit with the BOSS Trait permitted in this Posse.

rules.name: Quantrill's Raiders Theme Posse
rules.description: In an OUTLAWS/ENLIGHTENED/HEX Force, instead of a Faction Posse, William Quantrill may take this Theme Posse.  If all six slots are filled with at least one unit, when making a Charge, any unit in the Posse gains the Stone Cold Killer Special Rule for their Free Strike Action. William Quantrill is the only unit with the BOSS Trait permitted in this Posse

rules.name: The Regulators Theme Posse
rules.description: In an OUTLAWS/ENLIGHTENED/UNION/LAWMEN/HEX Force, instead of a Faction Posse, Billy The Kid may take this Theme Posse.  If all six slots in the Posse contain at least one unit in them, receive the following bonus: In an Outlaw/Hex/Enlightened Force, Billy the Kid gains the Treasure Hunter and Head Hunter Special Rules. In a Lawmen/Union Force, Billy the Kid and any Faces in the Posse gains the Dead or Alive Special Rule. Billy The Kid is the only unit with the BOSS Trait permitted in this Posse.

rules.name: The Cowboys Theme Posse
rules.description: In an OUTLAWS/ENLIGHTENED/HEX Force, instead of a Faction Posse, Johnny Ringo may take this Theme Posse.  If all six slots in the Posse contain at least one unit in them, Johnny Ringo and all Hands and Faces in the Posse gain the Shoulder to Shoulder rule. Johnny Ringo is the only unit with the BOSS Trait permitted in this Posse.

rules.name: Confederate Rebellion Theme Posse
rules.description:
In an OUTLAWS/HEX/ENLIGHTENED Force, instead of a Faction Posse, Stonewall Jackson may take this Theme Posse.

If all six slots are filled with at least one unit, every unit in the Posse gains the Elite rule.  Stonewall Jackson is the only unit with the BOSS Trait permitted in this Posse.  The Posse may be taken in an Enlightened, Hex, or Outlaws Force.

forceEntries.name: Raiders From the Nautilus Theme Posse

rules.name: Raiders From the Nautilus Theme Posse
rules.description: In an OUTLAWS Force, instead of a Faction Posse, Rani Nimue may take this Theme Posse.  Rani Nimue is the only unit with the BOSS Trait permitted in this Posse.

rules.name: The Bloody Espinosas
rules.description:
In an OUTLAWS/ENLIGHTENED/HEX Force, instead of a Faction Posse, Felipe Espinosa
may take this Theme Posse.
If the Posse contains at least four Espinosa units, then Felipe Espinosa gains +1
Fortune. Felipe Espinosa is the only unit with the BOSS Trait permitted in this Posse.

rules.name: Capacity (2)
rules.description: This unit may transport up to two small based models. Units transported in this manner gain the Hunkered condition.  Friendly units can be deployed already mounted in this unit.  Both units are deployed to the battlefield as a single deployment and the transported unit are considered to be mounted.  You cannot put a unit wuth Capacity inside this unit.

characteristics.$text: Revolver Fan, Ammo Clip, Close Work

rules.name: Even In Death (Sofia Antonela)
rules.description: This unit may only make Combat Actions with weapons with the Special quality if it is within 4" of Sofia Antonela.  Furthermore, while this unit is within 4" of Sofia Antonela, should she become nominated as the initial Target of an attack, this unit instead becomes the Initial Target of the attack.  If this occurs, you must still calculate range, Line of Sight and cover bonuses etc to Sofia Antonela but resolve the Grit Check on this unit instead.

rules.name: Mutagenesis
rules.description: This ability costs a Fortune Chip and may be used by this unit once per turn when a MUTATION Face, Hands, or Support unit is destroyed within 6" of this unit.  Immediately, before Taint Checks are made, d5 of the MUTATION models from the destroyed unit are returned to the Play Area within 3" of this unit.  Any model that cannot be placed does not return and is removed from play.  The returned MUTATION unit counts as having Activated for the turn and has the Reanimated rule. Mutagenesis cannot be used against units that are removed from play due to Yeller Checks.
